name: Azure DevOps pull request
changes: Says how to get az on each platform, and marks its sign-in, so the plugin's page can offer Set up and Sign in on the person's press.
description: Once a branch rule's landing has made its branch, pushes it to origin and opens a pull request with the az CLI's devops extension; and, where a look may remove a landed branch, says whether its pull request completed and with which commit.

tools.for: Pushes the commit the landing judged to the branch on origin.
Opens the pull request, and reads its status before pushing to it again and when a look asks whether it completed.
